mon.so_what: Writers whose books trained an AI start receiving money this week, and the split with their publisher decides whether a cheque is worth $2,203 or half of it: anyone with a book contract now knows which clause to read.
mon.story: The $1.5 billion Bartz v. Anthropic settlement starts paying authors and publishers from the week of 23 November 2026. The first instalment is about 70% of each work's share, $2,203.56, with the rest due once the AI company makes its final payment of about $450 million.
